obligatorio: This step is needed to continue
errorGuardar: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
bienvenidaTitulo: Your school is up and running.
bienvenidaCuerpo: Let's give it your name and your look. It takes two minutes, and you can change all of it later — so don't overthink it.
bienvenidaPunto1: Give it a name and a logo
bienvenidaPunto2: Create your first course, if you feel like it
bienvenidaPunto3: Invite your students whenever you want
nombreCuerpo: This is the name your students see when they log in, and the one that signs the emails you send them.
nombrePlaceholder: Sanz Academy, Aribau Training, School of Languages…
nombreAviso: Right now it's called "{nombre}", which came from your email at checkout. Give it its real name.
marcaCuerpo: Upload your logo and pick a colour. This is what makes your students feel they're at your place and not in some generic tool.
marcaLogoAyuda: A square image looks best. If you don't have one yet, skip it — you can add it later.
marcaColorAyuda: Slide until you find yours. You'll see it applied straight away.
marcaVista: This is how they'll see it
direccionCuerpo: This is where your students log in. You can share it right now.
direccionPropioTitulo: Want to use your own domain?
direccionPropioCuerpo: Something like "learn.yourschool.com". You can set it up whenever you like from Administration → Domains; it needs a couple of changes from whoever runs your website.
cursoCuerpo: An empty school is hard to make sense of. Create one now even if it's half-finished — you can change all of it later.
cursoCreado: Created. You can add lessons to it whenever you want.
cursoError: We couldn't create the course. You can do it later from Courses.
alumnosCuerpo: Type their emails and they'll get an invitation to join. If you'd rather do it later or upload a list, that's fine too.
alumnosEnviadas: {n, plural, one {Invitation sent} other {# invitations sent}}
alumnosError: Some invitations didn't go out. You can retry from Users.
cobrosTitulo: Will you charge for your courses?
cobrosCuerpo: If you sell training, you can connect your Stripe account and charge from here. The money goes straight to your account: we never touch it.
cobrosAyuda: If you only train your own team, skip this with no worries.
correoTitulo: Emails, with your name on them
correoCuerpo: Right now emails to your students go out from Didacta. You can make them come from your own address so they recognise you.
correoAyuda: It needs a few details that whoever runs your email or website will usually have. It's the most technical bit here, and there's no rush.
resumenCuerpo: Your school is yours now. Here's what's left, in case you want to carry on.
